# Sylloge: all entries

> Curated catalog of 109 web UI frameworks and 20 icon sets (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid, web components), with maintenance status computed from GitHub and npm. Curated by Garin Ramadhan. Data as of 2026-11-19.

Limits: A snapshot refreshed by hand, not live. Not exhaustive on purpose (entry rule: 1,000+ stars or 50,000+ weekly npm downloads, and a push within 180 days). "Best for", notes and warnings are the curator's opinion, not official project statements.
Read https://syllogeui.github.io/for-ai.md (a guide written for AI agents) for field meanings and how status is computed. Indonesian text for each entry is in https://syllogeui.github.io/data/entries.json.

## UI framework (109)

### shadcn/ui
- Page: https://syllogeui.github.io/ui/shadcn-ui/
- Type: UI framework, Tailwind and copy-paste
- Status: active (last push 2026-11-18)
- Stars: 128,530
- npm: shadcn 4.23.0, 18,886,105 downloads/week
- License: MIT
- Frameworks: React
- Styling: Tailwind
- Best for (curator's opinion): Custom products, Tailwind
- Curator note: The code is copied into your project instead of installed as a dependency. The de facto standard right now
- Repo: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui
- Site: https://ui.shadcn.com

- Page: https://syllogeui.github.io/ui/ant-design/

- Stars: 100,270
- npm: antd 6.7.1, 5,252,879 downloads/week
- License: MIT

- Styling: CSS-in-JS

- Curator note: Very complete, but it has a strong "Ant" look and needs theming for other brands

- Site: https://ant.design
